name: Suzan DelBene
stance: Calls for national AI guardrails and urged the House to stay in session until it passes AI safeguards.

statements.text: It's clear we need national guardrails to protect Americans from the threat AI poses, according to the very people building these programs. Trump & Republicans in Congress are asleep at the wheel.
Called on Speaker Johnson to keep the House in session until it passes AI safeguards.
